thresholds._comment: Trigger incidents for Vista priority 1, 2, and 3. Lower = more urgent.

paths._comment: Relative paths are relative to the folder of this config.json (C:\cts-api\cts-alarms on the CTS server): config, secrets, state, CSV audit trail and logs all live there. Only the Vista alarm file is absolute.

mainmanager._comment: Credentials live in secrets.json next to this config.json (paths.secrets_file; a relative path is relative to this file's folder) or in MM_USERNAME/MM_PASSWORD — never in this file. See secrets.example.json.

incident_defaults._comment: v3 write model (POST/PUT /api/v3/incidents). IncidentTypeID 277 = 'CTS API' (was CheckwordItemID); LocationID 6 = Rambøll HQ bygning; ReportedByID 748 = TacVista Automated Services, org 11 = Rambøll Danmark A/S; GradeID 10; StatusID 5 = Awaits handling (enforced with a PUT after create). Values as carried by every ticket the bot created since 2026-04.
